recipes.title: Chicken and Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cooked and diced
1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
recipes.instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).  Combine cooked chicken, rice, onion, cream of mushroom soup, and milk in a greased 9x13 inch baking dish.  Top with cheddar cheese and green onions (if using). Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until heated through and bubbly.

recipes.title: Chicken Fried Rice
recipes.instructions: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Add onion and stir-fry for 1 minute. Add eggs and scramble until cooked. Add rice, chicken, and soy sauce. Stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, or until heated through.  Add optional vegetables and stir-fry for another minute. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Simple Chicken and Rice with Onions
ingredients: 1 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch pieces
recipes.instructions: In a large pot or Dutch oven, sauté onion in a little oil until softened. Add chicken and cook until browned. Stir in rice, chicken broth, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until rice is cooked and liquid is absorbed.
